Type: round swivel tub accent chair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, lounge
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: velvet upholstery, padded cylindrical body, loose lumbar cushion, dark round swivel base
Colors: golden ochre brown, black base
Shape: curved enclosed tub back that wraps into a cylindrical body, armless, deep round seat, small back cushion, low disc swivel base, compact and rounded
Feel: warm, plush, cozy, rich
Goes with: walnut, brass, cream or dark green walls; mid-century or retro living rooms
